assumptions.actual_completion_fraction_model: completed_fraction or completion aliases from selected realized downlink contacts are averaged only when the selected contact ID matches exactly one effective candidate row
assumptions.actual_downlink_completion_ratio_model: matched selected realized throughput is divided by the declared downlink requirement to expose realized completion against the same requirement used for actual shortfall review
assumptions.actual_throughput_model: actual_throughput_mb, actual_data_volume_mb, actual data-rate duration products, or actual-downlink/delivered/received aliases from selected realized downlink contacts are summed only when the selected contact ID matches exactly one effective candidate row
assumptions.data_rate_throughput_model: when explicit MB throughput is absent, data_rate_mb_s or data_rate_mbps aliases multiplied by contact duration produce fixed-rate estimated throughput without link-budget modeling
assumptions.downlink_completion_source_model: explicit policy requirement sources or per-contact downlink completion source lineage are preserved for review
assumptions.downlink_requirement_model: explicit policy downlink requirement, station requirement, or per-contact required_downlink_mb compared to selected capacity-adjusted throughput
assumptions.invalid_contact_input: downlink-like candidate or selected inputs missing identity or station fields are preserved for operator review instead of being silently dropped or raising during capacity grouping
assumptions.per_contact_downlink_requirement_model: effective downlink contacts with required_downlink_mb contribute declared demand when no explicit policy requirement overrides them
assumptions.selected_contact_identity: selected contact IDs must match exactly one candidate row to count selected capacity
assumptions.unresolved_actual_completion_fraction_mo: selected realized downlink contacts with completion-fraction evidence are preserved as unmatched or ambiguous evidence when they cannot be reconciled to exactly one effective candidate row
assumptions.unresolved_actual_throughput_model: selected realized downlink contacts with actual throughput evidence are preserved as unmatched or ambiguous evidence when they cannot be reconciled to exactly one effective candidate row
